summary: OpenAI is previewing a new personal finance feature inside ChatGPT for U.S. Pro subscribers that connects to users' financial accounts to provide AI-powered financial insights and guidance.

categories.reason: A ChatGPT feature that connects to financial accounts and offers personalized financial guidance could compete with existing consumer fintech and financial-guidance apps.
categories.quote: Securely connect your financial accounts and get AI-powered insights and guidance grounded in your financial context, goals, and priorities.
